title: User Seats Included on Each Paloma Business Plan
content:
A Paloma Business plan includes a number of user seats in its subscription, sets a fee per billing month for each active user beyond the included seats, and caps the number of active users the plan allows.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| User seats included in the subscription | 1 | 3 | 5 | 10 | 25 | 100 |
| Extra seat fee (USD per billing month, per active user beyond the included seats) | 0.00 | 9.00 | 9.00 | 7.00 | 5.00 | 4.00 |
| Largest number of active users the plan allows | 1 | 5 | 15 | 40 | 100 | 400 |

### Notes to the table

1. The included seats, the extra seat fee and the largest number of active users are all counted in active users of one Paloma Business account.
2. On Paloma Business Starter the included seats and the largest number of active users are both 1, so no active user beyond the included seat can exist on that plan.
3. On every other plan the gap between the two rows is the room for active users who are beyond the included seats: 2 on Essentials, 10 on Growth, 30 on Pro, 75 on Scale and 300 on Enterprise.

### Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Paloma Business Pro account with 13 active users has 3 active users beyond its 10 included seats; each of those 3 is beyond the included seats, and the plan's extra seat fee for each is 7.00 USD per billing month. The same account is still below the plan's largest number of 40 active users.
